content.text: In regions where Stripe and PayPal restrict services, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators-11|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators face significant barriers to monetizing their work. Building a crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-what-actually-17|Cloudflare Webhook-Driven]] Pages offers an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-2|infrastructure]] solution that empowers creators to sell digital products without reliance on conventional payment platforms. This guide walks you through the setup process, ensuring your store is live and fully operational in under 48 hours. With the right tools and architecture, you can reclaim control over your online sales, harnessing the power of cryptocurrency for seamless transactions.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in developing markets, leaving them with limited options. By leveraging infrastructure solutions like Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, you establish a robust digital commerce stack that circumvents these barriers. This architecture allows for direct ownership and operation of your store, ensuring that you remain autonomous. The decentralized nature of cryptocurrency transactions further enhances reliability and reduces dependency on centralized systems, which can be susceptible to outages and restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting your deployment, gather essential resources. You will need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for Apps Script and file delivery, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which outlines the deployment steps clearly. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload. This preparation allows for a smoother deployment process. Additionally, consider your target audience and marketing strategy to effectively promote your store once it goes live.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Next, set up Google Apps Script to handle backend logic. This script will manage product orders and facilitate communication with NOWPayments for payment verification. Ensure you integrate your NOWPayments account correctly to allow seamless cryptocurrency transactions. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. This pipeline ensures that once a payment is confirmed, customers receive their products instantly, creating a smooth purchasing experience.
Own your infrastructure; don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and tested, it's time to go live. Promote your store URL, ensuring your audience knows where to find your products. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will automatically handle the transaction, confirming payment on-chain. Monitor the process closely during your initial transactions to ensure everything functions as intended. Use feedback from your first customers to refine the purchasing experience and address any issues that arise promptly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your store, focus on scaling your operations. Add more products to your inventory and consider enhancing your marketing efforts to reach a broader audience. Utilize the insights gained from initial transactions to optimize your payment and delivery processes. If you require additional features or customization, explore the Edge Commerce Stack, which offers advanced capabilities like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. This allows for greater security and professionalism in your store's communications.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I ensure my payment processing is secure?

Using NOWPayments for crypto transactions ensures secure processing without KYC requirements. It automatically confirms payments on-chain, providing a reliable transaction record. Regularly update your security settings on Cloudflare to enhance your store's protection.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable options for hosting your digital product store. Each platform provides robust hosting capabilities, but Cloudflare Pages offers additional features with superior scalability and performance.
What happens after I deploy Stack 01?

After deploying Stack 01, you will have a functional store that can process payments and deliver products. Ensure to test all aspects of the store, including payment confirmations and product delivery, for a seamless customer experience.
How quickly can I get my store running?

Stack 01 deployment takes approximately 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. This quick setup allows you to start selling digital products in a relatively short time frame while ensuring all components are functioning correctly.
What are the benefits of using Stack 02?

Stack 02, using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, provides enhanced features like better data management and scalability. It is deployed in 48 hours, fully tested, and ensures a professional setup with essential configurations for optimal performance.
